comments.message: Over 11. 14 runs. Bowler: Rishad Hossain. Australia Men: 3-112(rr 10.18)

The leg spinner bowls a short one on leg stump, and Tim David smashes a controlled, middled pull over deep square leg for six. Tim David's second six of the over seals the deal as Australia chase down the target comfortably with seven wickets in hand.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, back foot, cut along the ground to Nasum Ahmed at backward point. No run.

Rishad Hossain floats a leg spinner just outside off stump on a length. Tim David swings with intent, connecting nicely on a controlled slog over long on for a six. Tim David has got off the mark in style.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, drive uncontrolled in air to Saif Hassan at long off. OUT! Cooper Connolly caught - 15(13)

Rishad Hossain bowls a length googly on middle and leg, and Matt Renshaw confidently drives it along the ground toward long off, securing a quick single. Australia moves to 100 for 2 in their second innings.
Connolly meets the googly outside off with a controlled drive along the ground, nudging it neatly for a single to long off.
Over 10. 6 runs. Bowler: Saif Hassan. Australia Men: 2-98(rr 9.8)

The off break dips just outside off stump on a back of a length and Connolly leans into a neat drive through the covers, racing away for a single. Australia musters 12 runs from 60 balls, locked in with a strong winning chance.
An off break flights outside off on a length, with Renshaw scooping it cleverly behind square for a quick single.
Short and on off stump, the off break is worked neatly by Connolly toward the deep square leg region for a single.
An off break tossed up outside off, met with a clever scoop from Matt Renshaw who nudges it finely for a quick single.
Saif Hassan bowls an off break just outside off stump on a length; Cooper Connolly drives it crisply along the ground, picking up a single well fielded at deep cover.
Round the wicket. Short, off stump, front foot, scoop along the ground to Shoriful Islam at fine leg. 1 run.
Over 9. 10 runs. Bowler: Shoriful Islam. Australia Men: 2-92(rr 10.22)

On the back of a length outside off, a no-movement delivery sees Matt Renshaw gently push the ball through the slips. He picks up a single, helped by a misfield from the keeper running around to short third man. Australia face a chase needing 18 runs from 66 balls with eight wickets in hand, comfortably favored to win.
A full delivery on leg stump, worked carefully along the ground for a single to long on.
Shoriful Islam sends down an off cutter just outside off stump, length ball. Cooper Connolly leans into a crisp drive, keeping it grounded and guided firmly to extra cover, but no run comes from it.
A half-tracker outside off is left alone by the batter. The bowler concedes a wide, adding an extra run to the total.
On a length ball outside off, Matt Renshaw carefully works the ball into the on-side for a single. Renshaw gets off the mark.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, drive uncontrolled in air to Shamim Hossain at deep cover. OUT! Mitch Marsh caught - 60(28)
No movement outside off as the length ball is met with a beautifully controlled drive. Mitch Marsh times it superbly, sending it racing over extra cover for six.
Over 8. 8 runs. Bowler: Rishad Hossain. Australia Men: 1-82(rr 10.25)

This back of a length leg spinner on middle stump is worked nicely by the batter for a quick single, keeping the scoreboard ticking. Australia chase 28 from 72 balls with nine wickets in hand, holding a strong 99% winning probability.
Over the wicket. Back of a length, outside off, front foot, sweep. No run.
This leg spinner, landing at the back of a length on off stump, is worked carefully by the batter along the ground, but no run comes from it.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, slog-sweep. 6 runs.
Over the wicket. Back of a length, outside off, back foot, cut along the ground to Shamim Hossain at deep cover. 1 run.
Rishad Hossain bowls a back of a length leg spinner outside off, and Cooper Connolly attempts a sharp cut but misses entirely, resulting in a dot ball.
Over 7. 20 runs. Bowler: Nahid Rana. Australia Men: 1-74(rr 10.57)

Connolly drives a full delivery outside off with crisp timing, sending it low and running a quick single. Australia reach 20 runs in this over, needing 36 from 78 balls with a comfortable position and strong chances of victory.
Over the wicket. Length ball, middle stump, front foot, drive. 4 runs.

A full delivery on the outside off stump is met with a well-timed drive. Cooper Connolly sends it crisply through extra cover, racing away to the boundary. Fifteen runs already in this over! Cooper Connolly is off the mark.
Mitch Marsh drives with precision just outside off stump, timing it beautifully along the ground to pick up a quick single despite a smart stop from mid off.
A length ball outside off stump, cleanly driven by Mitch Marsh. That well-timed, controlled drive races crisply through extra cover for four. Mitch Marsh has already struck two boundaries this over.
A length ball on off stump with no movement, and Mitch Marsh flicks it with superb timing. The controlled shot sails over deep backward square leg for a six.
Over 6. 2 runs. Bowler: Nasum Ahmed. Australia Men: 1-54(rr 9)

A length ball angling on off stump, worked quietly by the batter into the off side for no run. Australia require 56 runs from 84 balls with plenty of wickets in hand, holding a strong chance to chase.
Round the wicket. Back of a length, outside off, back foot, drive uncontrolled in air to Shamim Hossain at deep mid wicket. OUT! Josh Inglis caught - 17(16)
A length stock ball outside off, met with a controlled shot worked through the off side. No run comes off this delivery.
Round the wicket. Back of a length, outside off, back foot, drive along the ground to Tawhid Hridoy at mid wicket. No run.
Round the wicket. Back of a length, outside off, back foot, pushed along the ground to Rishad Hossain at long off. 1 run.
Round the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, drive along the ground to Saif Hassan at extra cover. 1 run.
Over 5. 18 runs. Bowler: Taskin Ahmed. Australia Men: 0-52(rr 10.4)

Taskin Ahmed delivers a length ball outside off, which Mitch Marsh meets with a perfectly timed drive. The ball races crisply through cover for four runs. Mitch Marsh smashes his fourth boundary this over, taking the partnership to 52 runs from 30 balls. Australia moves to 52 without loss, needing 58 from 90 with all wickets intact and a 97% chance to win.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, drive. 4 runs.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, drive along the ground to Shamim Hossain at deep cover. 1 run.
Marsh drives a length ball outside off stump with a controlled, ground stroke, picking up a quick single.

A length ball just outside off stump with no movement, met with a well-timed drive through extra cover. The ball races away courtesy of a misfield by Saif Hassan. Another boundary for Mitch Marsh, his second of the over.
Over the wicket. Length ball, outside off, front foot, drive. 4 runs.
Over 4. 6 runs. Bowler: Nasum Ahmed. Australia Men: 0-34(rr 8.5)

A length ball outside off, and Marsh drives it nicely along the ground, finding the gap and picking up a well-run single. Australia are chasing 76 from 96 balls, comfortably placed with all wickets in hand and a strong winning probability.
Nasum Ahmed bowls a back of a length stock ball on off stump and Marsh works it carefully towards backward square leg for no run.
A stock ball pitched back of a length just outside off stump, met with a neat flick from Josh Inglis who nudges it off the pads for a single.
Nasum bowls a full stock ball on middle stump, and Inglis drives it elegantly with perfect timing through the covers for two runs, nearly cut off by a quick fielder.
Marsh drives a yorker-length stock ball straight down the ground, guiding it carefully for a well-placed single.
Round the wicket. Length ball, middle stump, back foot, worked along the ground to Shoriful Islam at backward square leg. 1 run.
Over 3. 9 runs. Bowler: Taskin Ahmed. Australia Men: 0-28(rr 9.33)

Josh Inglis deftly flicks the no-movement ball from just outside off stump, caressing it along the ground for a neat single. Australia face a chase requiring 82 runs off 102 balls with 10 wickets in hand, holding a 95% win probability according to WinViz.
Marsh steps into a back-of-a-length delivery outside off and rides the ball in a controlled slog towards deep backward square leg, sneaking a single.

Taskin Ahmed bowls a length ball just outside off, but Mitch Marsh steps forward and drives it beautifully. The shot is well timed and controlled, sailing over long on for a glorious six. That’s the first six of the innings.
Taskin Ahmed pitches an off cutter just outside off stump, and Mitch Marsh attempts a drive but mistimes it, resulting in a simple fielded ball at mid-off with no run.
Over the wicket. Back of a length, outside off, down the track, drive along the ground to Tawhid Hridoy at mid off. No run.
Taskin Ahmed fires in a full-length delivery outside off, and Josh Inglis confidently drives it along the ground, picking up a single.
Over 2. 2 runs. Bowler: Nasum Ahmed. Australia Men: 0-19(rr 9.5)

The stock ball lands on a length, aimed at middle stump. Mitch Marsh pushes but misses the connection, the ball hitting his pad and then fielded cleanly by the bowler. Australia require 91 runs from 108 balls with all wickets still in hand; they hold the upper hand with a 94% win probability.
The stock ball comes in on middle stump at length, and the batter pushes it with an inside edge for a quick single.
The stock ball is pitched back of a length outside off and met with a controlled drive by Josh Inglis, but the shot is well fielded at cover, yielding no run.
Nasum Ahmed pitches a back of a length stock ball on off stump, and Josh Inglis pushes it neatly back towards the bowler for no run.
Nasum Ahmed bowls a length stock ball on off stump; Inglis pushes it gently towards cover where the fielder is alert. No run from this delivery.
A solid stock ball pitched back of a length outside off, expertly driven through the covers for a well-timed single.
Over 1. 17 runs. Bowler: Shoriful Islam. Australia Men: 0-17(rr 17)

A back of a length delivery on leg stump with no movement from the bowler. Inglis pushes it with perfect timing, gliding the ball sharply through third man for a classy four. Josh Inglis adds another boundary, totaling 17 runs this over. Australia are chasing 93 from 114 balls, comfortably placed with a strong win probability and all wickets in hand.
A length ball straight on off stump with no movement. Josh Inglis steps in and drives it crisply through extra cover for a well-timed boundary. Josh Inglis is off the mark.
A back of a length delivery on the leg side is worked off the body by Mitch Marsh, but no run comes as the ball is fielded cleanly at silly point.
A length ball on leg stump without much movement, driven with a thick, uncontrolled edge. The shot races away to third man for four. Mitch Marsh adds another boundary, his second four in this over.
Shoriful Islam pitches a length ball outside off, and Mitch Marsh attempts a drive but misses it cleanly, resulting in no run.
A length ball outside off stump is met with a beautifully controlled, well-timed drive. Mitch Marsh elegantly pierces the gap through long off for a crisp boundary. Mitch Marsh is off the mark.
